ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit theft via ntdsutil 'Install From Media' (IFM)
ucs.description: Hunts ntdsutil.exe being driven with IFM/`create full` semantics to snapshot the Active Directory database — the documented, malware-free credential-access technique attributed to Volt Typhoon / Vanguard Panda (CISA AA24-038A). Catches the actor's signature LOTL ntds.dit extraction on domain controllers, where they avoid Mimikatz/secretsdump because they leave EDR fingerprints.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="ntdsutil.exe" (Processes.process="*ac i ntds*" OR Processes.process="*activate instance ntds*" OR Processes.process="*ifm*" OR Processes.process="*create full*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT match(user, "\$$")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe" or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ac i ntds", "activate instance ntds", " ifm", "create full")
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("ac i ntds", "activate instance ntds", " ifm", "create full")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith @"\ntdsutil.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("ac i ntds", "activate instance ntds", " ifm", "create full")
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| where TargetUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon ntdsutil IFM-based NTDS.dit extraction
id: f9b8a3a1-8e6f-4d1c-9a7b-7e0a3a1f2c10
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects ntdsutil.exe driven with Install-From-Media (IFM) semantics
  (`ac i ntds` + `ifm` + `create full`) to snapshot the Active Directory
  database. Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE) uses this LOTL
  technique against domain controllers in U.S. critical-infrastructure
  intrusions to harvest NTDS.dit + SYSTEM hive without dropping malware.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/blog/falcon-complete-thwarts-vanguard-panda-tradecraft/
author: SOC Detection Team
date: 2026/06/18
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'ntdsutil.exe'
  selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ac i ntds'
      - 'activate instance ntds'
      - ' ifm'
      - 'create full'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cli and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Authorized DC promotion / IFM backup jobs (should be from change-managed accounts)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - detection.threat_actor.volt_typhoon
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\ntdsutil.exe OR *\NTDSUTIL.EXE OR *\Ntdsutil.exe) (@CommandLine:(*"ac i ntds"* OR *"activate instance ntds"* OR *" ifm "* OR *"create full"*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/ntdsutil\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(ac\\s+i\\s+ntds|activate\\s+instance\\s+ntds|\\sifm\\b|create\\s+full)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
| sort(_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: ntdsutil IFM extraction is the documented Volt Typhoon credential-theft pattern from CISA AA24-038A and CrowdStrike's Vanguard Panda reporting — they deliberately reject Mimikatz/secretsdump-style dumping because those generate well-known EDR signals. The `ac i ntds` + `ifm` + `create full` command shape is rare in benign environments (only DC promotion / change-managed backup jobs), so this catch

ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon internal pivot via netsh portproxy v4tov4
ucs.description: Hunts `netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4` invocations used by Volt Typhoon / VOLTZITE to relay attacker traffic across compromised hosts into segmented OT/IT networks and out through their KV-botnet SOHO-device infrastructure. Pairs the LOLBin with the specific subcommand chain that distinguishes adversary use from rare admin port-forwarding.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="netsh.exe" Processes.process="*portproxy*" (Processes.process="*add v4tov4*" OR Processes.process="*add v4tov6*" OR Processes.process="*add v6tov4*" OR Processes.process="*add v6tov6*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT match(user, "\$$")
| rex field=process "listenport=(?<listenport>\d+).*?connectport=(?<connectport>\d+).*?connectaddress=(?<connectaddress>[\w\.\:]+)"
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName =~ "netsh.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "portproxy"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("add v4tov4", "add v4tov6", "add v6tov4", "add v6tov6")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend ListenPort   = extract(@"(?i)listenport=(\S+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend ConnectPort  = extract(@"(?i)connectport=(\S+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend ConnectAddr  = extract(@"(?i)connectaddress=(\S+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine,
          ListenPort, ConnectPort, ConnectAddr,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith @"\netsh.exe"
| where CommandLine has "portproxy"
| where CommandLine has_any ("add v4tov4", "add v4tov6", "add v6tov4", "add v6tov6")
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| where TargetUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend ListenPort  = extract(@"(?i)listenport=(\S+)", 1, CommandLine)
| extend ConnectPort = extract(@"(?i)connectport=(\S+)", 1, CommandLine)
| extend ConnectAddr = extract(@"(?i)connectaddress=(\S+)", 1, CommandLine)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          ListenPort, ConnectPort, ConnectAddr, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon netsh portproxy internal pivot
id: 1c4d8b22-7a1e-4f3d-8c2b-9e2a6b5c1f04
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects `netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4` (and v4tov6/v6tov4)
  invocations used by Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE) as an
  internal proxy to relay attacker traffic through compromised hosts
  into segmented networks and outbound via their KV-botnet SOHO
  relay infrastructure. Pairs the LOLBin with the specific
  subcommand chain that distinguishes adversary use from rare admin
  port-forwarding.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-144a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/05/24/volt-typhoon-targets-us-critical-infrastructure-with-living-off-the-land-techniques/
author: SOC Detection Team
date: 2026/06/18
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\netsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'netsh.exe'
  selection_sub:
    CommandLine|contains: 'portproxy'
  selection_verb:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'add v4tov4'
      - 'add v4tov6'
      - 'add v6tov4'
      - 'add v6tov6'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_sub and selection_verb and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate sysadmin port forwarding for service migrations (should be change-managed and infrequent)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1090.001
  - detection.threat_actor.volt_typhoon
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\netsh.exe OR *\NETSH.EXE OR *\Netsh.exe) @CommandLine:*portproxy* @CommandLine:(*"add v4tov4"* OR *"add v4tov6"* OR *"add v6tov4"* OR *"add v6tov6"*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/netsh\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)portproxy", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)add\\s+v[46]tov[46]", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| ListenPort     := regex("(?i)listenport=(?<lp>\\S+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false) | rename(field=lp, as=ListenPort)
| ConnectAddr    := regex("(?i)connectaddress=(?<ca>\\S+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false) | rename(field=ca, as=ConnectAddr)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
| sort(_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Microsoft's May 2023 Volt Typhoon report and CISA AA23-144A explicitly call out `netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4` as the actor's preferred internal-pivot mechanism — they chain it from compromised edge devices (Fortinet/Cisco/Ivanti) into Windows servers that then proxy to internal critical-infrastructure hosts. Generic netsh detections drown the SOC in admin noise; gating on `portproxy` + `a
